title: leucanthemopsis pallida var. alpina
intro: Leucanthemopsis pallida var. alpina, commonly known as Mountain Everlasting, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to address various health issues, with potential benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating respiratory and cardiovascular conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Everlasting are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Leucanthemopsis pallida var. alpina for medicinal purposes.
